definition: ANSWERED calls / total unique call_id after exact-dup drop
why: Answered is the only status that implies a live ring pickup in this schema

definition: Dispositions in {PTP, PROMISE_TO_PAY, PAID, CALLBACK, DISPUTE, REFUSED, PTP_BROKEN} / all dispositions
why: Harmonizes PTP synonyms; excludes NO_CONTACT and WRONG_NUMBER
Promise intensity among right-party contacts, not among all dials
Includes OPEN/CANCELLED in the denominator so forecasts are not optimistic

definition: Accounts with ≥1 clean SUCCESS payment / all snapshot accounts (30,000)
why: Does not drop WRITEOFF/CLOSED; avoids denominator manipulation

definition: Clean SUCCESS amount / sum(session logout-login hours)
why: Payments have no agent_id; this is a portfolio-level proxy only

definition: Not observed in data; scenario costs are labeled assumptions
why: Do not treat unit-cost folklore as empirical

definition: Accounts with a channel touch who later have a clean SUCCESS, vs 7-day last-touch cash share
why: Last-touch is association; conversion is not incremental lift

definition: Clean SUCCESS in month / observed days in month (Aug = 8, not 31)
